name: Terry Davis: It's in God's Hands
aliases: you don't have to worry about the world
no reason to panic over global warming
fuck it it ain't our business
description: Terry Davis on a street in a black hoodie: "There's no reason to panic over global warming. It's part of God's plan... It's under control. Just relax. You don't have to worry about the world. It's in God's hands. Fuck it. He knows what he's doing."
usage: Letting go of what you can't control: deploy on Friday, let the market do its thing, stop doomscrolling.

source.author: @Davisanism
source.example: "You don't have to worry about the world. It's in God's hands."
